digest.component_or_area: binding repository and state persistence layer
propositions: BindingRepository must round-trip legacy and unknown-field fixtures to byte-identical sorted/indented JSON with trailing newline and perform no eager writes on construction
Calling save must unconditionally attempt rotation persistence before live file replacement, retaining inline last_get_pass on rotation failure
Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open and attempt best-effort deduped alerting

Rotation, retired, and live file persistence failures must follow strict ordering: rotation failure is swallowed; retired/live failures raise and leave state unchanged; alert failure is always swallowed
After a rotation write failure, the next successful save must converge the sidecar from the retained inline floor before live replacement
All persistence operations must use tempfile/write/replace pattern with per-file cleanup and must not implement multi-file atomicity, journaling, eager-load rewrites, or write-elision claims
